jd_issues.detail: Cerebras Systems 'AI Fleet Platform Software Engineer' is labeled seniority 'new_grad', but the description explicitly states 'We are seeking a senior software engineer to design, implement, and maintain the platform software...' and requires '12+ years of industry experience building and operating production distributed systems or large-scale infrastructure software'. Staff/Senior level role outside early/mid career scope.

OpenAI 'Software Engineer, ChatGPT Infrastructure' is labeled seniority 'new_grad', but the job description explicitly opens with: 'We’re hiring Senior and Staff Engineers to design and build infrastructure systems that underlie ChatGPT'. Senior/Staff level role outside early/mid career scope.

OpenAI 'Network Infrastructure Engineer, Global Network Infra (WAN)' is labeled SWE 'infra', but is a physical network/telecom infrastructure engineering role requiring 'activation and turn-up of network circuits, working directly with fiber carriers... optical signal problems, FEC errors... port mappings, fiber and cable layouts, optical distribution frames (ODFs)'. Pure hardware/cable technician roles are explicitly out of scope per JD_SPEC.

Microsoft 'Research Intern - Efficient AI Software Systems' contains only an EEO legal notice and an application deadline ('Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer... The deadline for this posting is Sunday, November 23, 2025'). It completely lacks any role description, duties, or technical requirements.

General Motors '2027 Summer Intern – Autonomous Driving Software Engineer' is abruptly truncated mid-sentence at the very end ('- Complete assigned…') and provides zero qualifications or job requirements.

IBM 'AI Software Engineer Intern 2027' contains only a portal metadata summary table ('Job Title AI Software Engineer Intern 2027
Job ID 67890
Location San Jose, CA
Category Engineering
Employment Type Full-time
Salary Range $35 - $50 / hr') and completely lacks any role description, responsibilities, or technical qualifications.

Cursor 'Software Engineer, Generalist' contains only SpaceX boilerplate ('SpaceX is committed to creating a diverse environment...') followed immediately by 'Software Engineer, Generalist\n\n#LI-DNI'. It completely lacks any role description, responsibilities, or requirements.

Palantir 'Software Engineer - New Grad - France' contains a French introductory section followed by full English job description ('Palantir se consacre à la résolution des problèmes opérationnels les plus difficiles... You are a fit for this role if you: have a strong background in Computer Science...'). Complete English text is preserved.

Lyft 'Software Engineer (Mexico)' contains a Spanish introduction followed by full English job description ('En Lyft estamos transformando la movilidad... Responsibilities: As a Software Engineer...'). Complete English text is preserved.

Blend 'Software Engineer - AI Native (Full Stack)' is labeled role_family 'ai_ml', but the role is full-stack web application development using AI coding assistants ('full-stack software engineer who will use AI coding agents to ship web applications'). Relabel role_family to 'general_swe'.

Cluely 'Founding Engineer (Fullstack TypeScript)' is labeled role_family 'backend' and seniority 'new_grad'. The title and requirements describe a founding full-stack engineer ($250k-$350k base salary, 60-72 hrs/week). Relabel role_family to 'general_swe' and seniority to 'mid'.

Superhuman 'Software Engineer, Full-Stack' (Porto) is labeled role_family 'backend', but the title and responsibilities describe full-stack web application development across frontend and backend. Relabel role_family to 'general_swe'.

Superhuman 'Software Engineer, Full-Stack' (San Francisco) is labeled role_family 'backend' and seniority 'new_grad'. The role is full-stack, and explicitly requires 'Brings at least three years of experience in Full-Stack development'. Relabel role_family to 'general_swe' and seniority to 'mid'.
Wealthfront 'Backend Engineer' is labeled seniority 'new_grad', but explicitly requires '2-6 years of experience in developing backend components'. Relabel seniority to 'mid'.
Wynd Labs 'Backend Engineer (TypeScript)' is labeled seniority 'new_grad', but explicitly requires '2+ years of experience in a backend software engineering role'. Relabel seniority to 'mid'.

Chalk 'Full Stack Software Engineer' is labeled role_family 'backend', but the description specifies 'work across all layers of the software stack: frontend React/TypeScript, backend Go/Python'. Relabel role_family to 'general_swe'.

Netic 'Founding Web Platform Engineer' is labeled role_family 'infra', but the core responsibilities focus on frontend: 'Build the Design System and Component Library... Deep React and TypeScript fluency; strong Next.js experience'. Relabel role_family to 'frontend'.

Sierra 'Deployed Infrastructure Engineer' is labeled seniority 'new_grad', but explicitly requires '4+ years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, or deployment engineering'. Relabel seniority to 'mid'.

ElevenLabs 'Data Engineer' is labeled seniority 'new_grad', but explicitly seeks an 'experienced Data Engineer... Demonstrated experience formalising and scaling data pipelines'. Relabel seniority to 'mid'.
Wealthfront 'Android Engineer' is labeled seniority 'new_grad', but explicitly requires '2 - 6 years of professional Android development experience'. Relabel seniority to 'mid'.

Wealthfront 'Software Engineer – DevOps Platform' is labeled seniority 'new_grad', but explicitly requires '2+ years of experience developing reliable production-grade software in Java, Go, or other similar languages' and 'Successfully designed and deployed mission-critical complex distributed systems'. Relabel seniority to 'mid'.
Wealthfront 'iOS Engineer' is labeled seniority 'new_grad', but explicitly requires '2 - 6 years of professional iOS development experience'. Relabel seniority to 'mid'.

Zoox 'Contract Student Worker  – Firmware Engineer (FW Thermal/Body)' is labeled seniority 'new_grad', but the text states: 'About Our Part Time Student Worker Program... Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program... Currently pursuing a B.S. or M.S.... Available for a 6 month project... $30 per hour... contract position'. Should be relabeled to 'intern'.

Zoox 'Contract Student Worker - Machine Learning Engineer - Data Mining & VLM (Full-time)' is labeled seniority 'new_grad', but the text states: 'About Our Part-Time Student Worker Program... Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program... Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment... $30/hour... contract position'. Should be relabeled to 'intern'.
Netic 'Full-Stack Software Engineer (Product) - Intern' is labeled role_family 'backend', but the title and responsibilities cover full-stack engineering. Relabel role_family to 'general_swe'.
Agave 'Full-Stack Software Engineer (New Grad)' is labeled role_family 'backend', but the title and responsibilities cover full-stack engineering. Relabel role_family to 'general_swe'.

resume_issues.detail: C++ is listed in the skills array (['Query Optimization', 'Databases', 'C++']), but the description ('Extended a teaching database's optimizer with a cost-based join reordering pass using dynamic programming over subsets. Compared plans against the original greedy optimizer on the course's benchmark queries.') contains no mention of C++ or any language used. Ines's persona summary specifically specifies 'Rust and C# backend experience' without mentioning C++.

Hibernate is listed in the skills array, but the description only mentions 'Spring Boot' and 'replaced N+1 queries with a single JPA fetch join', with no explicit mention of Hibernate. While Hibernate is the standard JPA provider under Spring Data, an ATS matching on exact textual evidence cannot verify Hibernate from the description.

Load Balancing is listed in skills for r14-e3, but the description ('Deployed a three-tier demo app on GCP with managed instance groups, then ran failure experiments killing instances and injecting latency. Wrote a report on which alerts fired and how long recovery took in each run.') mentions managed instance groups rather than explicitly stating load balancing.
